Name: (CP) Colorful Carrots
Author: AngelOfStars
Description:
I wanted to get some practice in with creating mail, crops, recipes, and adding gift tastes so I figured this would be the perfect way to do so!

This mod adds four new types of carrots to the game that are grown in different seasons and three new recipes. 

[b][u]> Carrot Cake:[/u][/b]
[spoiler] - Unlocked by getting eight hearts with Jodi
[b]﻿Ingredients:[/b]
﻿- 2 Carrots
﻿- 1 Sugar
﻿- 1 Egg
﻿- 1 Hazelnut
﻿- 1 Wheat Flour
[b]Buffs:[/b]
﻿+1 Speed
﻿+30 Max Energy[/spoiler]

[b][u]> Honey Roasted Rainbow Carrots:[/u][/b]
[spoiler]﻿- Unlocked by getting four hearts with the Dwarf
[b]﻿Ingredients:[/b]
﻿- 1 Purple Carrot
﻿- 1 Red Carrot
﻿- 1 White Carrot
﻿- 1 Yellow Carrot
﻿- 1 Honey[/spoiler]

[u][b]> Carrot Stew:[/b][/u]
[spoiler]- Unlocked by getting eight hearts with the Dwarf
[b]﻿Ingredients:[/b]
﻿- 1 Purple Carrot
﻿﻿- 1 Red Carrot
﻿- 1 White Carrot
﻿- 1 Yellow Carrot
﻿- 1 Carrot
﻿- 1 Cave Carrot
﻿- 1 Tomato
[b]﻿Buffs:[/b]
﻿+1 Farming
﻿+3 Mining
﻿+10 Magnetism
﻿+1 Defense[/spoiler]

[b][u]>Growing Time and Season:[/u][/b]
[spoiler][b]Yellow Carrots[/b]: Spring, 3 days
[b]Red Carrots:[/b] Summer, 5 days
[b]Purple Carrots:[/b] Fall, 4 days
[b]White Carrots: [/b]Winter, 6 days[/spoiler]

[b][u]> How to get the new Carrots:[/u][/b]
[spoiler]Sell at least one carrot, and reach two hearts with the Dwarf. The next day they will send you a letter in the mail letting you know you can trade the vanilla carrot seeds for the others.[/spoiler]

[b]If you like the stuff I make, consider sending me a [/b][b][url=https://ko-fi.com/lilydoesthingssometimes]ko-fi[/url]﻿ - never required of course, I do this stuff for fun, but it does make it easier to focus on making things.[/b]
